Jaipur Student Dies After Eating Canteen Food; Investigation Underway

A Class 12 student in Jaipur died at school after consuming a patty from the canteen. The student, identified as Prince Soni, reportedly fell ill shortly after eating the food. Following the death, protests erupted, and the student's family has alleged negligence. Police have detained two individuals in connection with the incident, and CCTV footage from before the student's death has reportedly emerged. An investigation is ongoing.
